name: Aiman Zulkifli
bio:
Aiman's passion for motorsport ignited during his engineering studies at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia. He immersed himself in Formula Student, leading his team's aerodynamics division for two years. This hands-on experience fueled his desire to work directly with race teams, leading him to pursue opportunities in data analysis and simulation. After graduating, Aiman interned at a smaller racing outfit before securing a role at Hitech GP. 

As a test driver coordinator, Aiman excels at bridging the gap between engineering and driver feedback. He believes in fostering open communication to translate intricate technical data into actionable strategies for on-track performance. His dedication to precision and his ability to see the broader implications of test data make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Aiman is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations, even during casual conversations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of whiteboard markers because he believes they write more smoothly.
